::: {.home-bio}
Welcome! I am a PhD student in Economics at [The University of Texas at Austin](https://liberalarts.utexas.edu/economics/){target="_blank"}.

My research interests are in macroeconomics, behavioral macroeconomics, and monetary economics. In particular, I study how households and firms form expectations, and how these beliefs shape macroeconomic dynamics and the transmission of monetary policy.
